title: Every Quantum Run Needs a Referee — reproduction package
description: Experiment scripts, raw results (including IBM Quantum job IDs), solver modules and LaTeX source for the paper 'Every Quantum Run Needs a Referee: Design and Empirical Lessons from a Vendor-Neutral Hybrid Quantum-Classical Platform'. Nine experiments: amplitude estimation vs classical Monte Carlo, exact MILP referee for facility location, Rydberg MIS mapping, sample-based diagonalization with classical and uniform-noise controls, vehicle routing, QAOA vs random sampling, and a hardware round on IBM Heron (ibm_marrakesh).
